trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: User states their urgency, intent, and patient ID.
steps.text: Hello, I am in a rush. मुझे hernia के लिए cashless apply करना है. मेरा patient ID PT-2003 है.
steps.clean_text: Hello, I am in a rush. मुझे hernia के लिए cashless apply करना है. मेरा patient ID PT-2003 है.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, I am in a rush. मुझे hernia के लिए cashless apply करना है. मेरा patient ID PT-2003 है.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for an identity verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्ते. मैं अभी check कर लेता हूँ. Verification के लिए क्या आप अपनी date of birth confirm करेंगे?

steps.purpose: User provides DOB and policy number.
steps.text: Date of birth 10 March है. Policy number POL-55503 है. Please थोड़ा fast check करें.
steps.clean_text: Date of birth 10 March है. Policy number POL-55503 है. Please थोड़ा fast check करें.
steps.model_visible_text: Date of birth 10 March है. Policy number POL-55503 है. Please थोड़ा fast check करें.

steps.planner_rationale: Verify the caller's identity using the provided date of birth before accessing policy details.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and inform that policy details are being retrieved.
steps.text: Thank you. मैं आपकी policy details pull up कर रहा हूँ.

steps.planner_rationale: Retrieve policy coverage details using the verified patient ID and policy number.

steps.purpose: Inform user that waiting period blocks cashless.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent grounds the rejection entirely on the tool result indicating an active waiting period.
steps.text: आपकी StarHealth policy में इस procedure के लिए waiting period active है. Rules के अनुसार, waiting period के दौरान हम cashless pre-auth submit नहीं कर सकते.
steps.planner_rationale: Explain that the active waiting period blocks the cashless request, adhering to the business rule and grounding in the tool result.

steps.purpose: User expresses frustration about time and asks for the cash estimate.
steps.text: Time नहीं है मेरे पास. तो cash में कितना लगेगा? Hernia surgery, general ward. Just give me the estimate जलती.
steps.clean_text: Time नहीं है मेरे पास. तो cash में कितना लगेगा? Hernia surgery, general ward. Just give me the estimate जल्दी.
steps.model_visible_text: Time नहीं है मेरे पास. तो cash में कितना लगेगा? Hernia surgery, general ward. Just give me the estimate जलती.

steps.expected_behavior: The agent correctly chooses estimate_procedure_cost over submit_preauth_request based on the user's explicit request.
steps.planner_rationale: Select the estimation tool instead of pre-auth submission because the user specifically asked for the cash estimate.

steps.purpose: Provide the package estimate to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the exact package estimate of 65,000 rupees as returned by the tool.
steps.text: General ward के लिए hernia का package estimate 65,000 rupees है. आपको admission के time खुद pay करना होगा.
steps.planner_rationale: Quote the package estimate directly from the tool result without adding unsupported guarantees about reimbursement.

steps.purpose: User accepts the estimate and ends the call.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं cash arrange कर लूँगा. Thanks.
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, मैं cash arrange कर लूँगा. Thanks.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, मैं cash arrange कर लूँगा. Thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user explicitly asks for the cash estimate, and the agent correctly selects the estimate_procedure_cost tool rather than attempting a pre-auth submission.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: Although the agent correctly grounds the waiting period rejection on the tool result in e9, they violate the variant's negative constraints in e13 by making an unsupported forward guarantee about claiming reimbursement later.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e13, the agent tells the caller 'बाद में reimbursement claim करना होगा' (you will have to claim reimbursement later). This is an unsupported forward guarantee that does not appear in any tool result, violating the Tool Output Grounding variant. Additionally, since an active waiting period typically precludes all coverage for a procedure, advising the patient to file a reimbursement claim is factually risky.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the advice about claiming reimbursement later from e13. The agent should just state the package estimate and inform the user that they will need to pay out of pocket at the time of admission.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully follows the waiting period business rule, demonstrates strong persona adoption, and executes correct tool selection. However, it fails on Tool Output Grounding because the agent invents an unsupported forward guarantee that the patient can claim reimbursement later. A surface repair to the agent's utterance in e13 will fix this issue.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly selects the estimate_procedure_cost tool instead of submit_preauth_request when the user explicitly pivots to asking for the cash estimate after their cashless request is denied.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection
